domainPull: The pull is strongest at the moult. In biology a moult sheds a casing, not half the body. 'Every chamber halves and the shed mass is discarded' plus 'any split rounds down' invites rounding the shed part down, which keeps the ceiling, and that reading changes the result (loss 92, plus an extra moult in cycle 5). Secondary pulls: the PUPAL-to-LARVAL reversal, which is biologically impossible and which the write-up pre-empts with 'that's routine, log it and move on'; 'reabsorb', which suggests the chamber keeps the mass; feeding PUPAL chambers, which do not feed in biology; and 'the chamber ahead', where 'ahead' could read as the next developmental stage (downstream) if '(one number lower)' were missed. Nobody can be shown to have fallen for any of these, because no operator output exists.
